007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ProfileAttributes;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for setting multiple Select AI profile attributes.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a {@link ProfileAttributes} payload, call {@link Profile#setAttributes(ProfileAttributes)}, and print whether the bulk update succeeded.</p>
021 *
022 * <p>To run this sample with an object list that references the Oracle
023 * sample schema objects {@code SH.CUSTOMERS} and {@code SH.COUNTRIES}, ensure
024 * the {@code SH} schema is installed and visible to {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}.
025 * The {@code SH} schema is not guaranteed to exist in every Oracle Autonomous
026 * AI Database or Oracle Database instance. If those objects are not available,
027 * set {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_OBJECT_LIST} to objects visible to
028 * {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, or omit the object list and rely on the configured
029 * object-list mode.</p>
030 *
031 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
040 * <ul>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_COMMENTS - defaults to {@code true}.</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_CONSTRAINTS - defaults to {@code true}.</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_CASE_SENSITIVE_VALUES - defaults to {@code false}.</li>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_MAX_TOKENS - defaults to {@code 1024}.</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_ADDITIONAL_INSTRUCTIONS</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_ROLE</li>
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
050 * <pre>{@code
051 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
052 * }</pre>
053 *
054 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
055 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
056 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
057 * <pre>{@code
058 * mvn clean install
059 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
060 * }</pre>
061 *
062 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
063 * <pre>{@code
064 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/SetProfileAttributesSample.java
065 * }</pre>
066 *
067 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
068 * <pre>{@code
069 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.SetProfileAttributesSample
070 * }</pre>
071 *
072 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
073 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
074 * and diagnostics.</p>
075 */
076public final class SetProfileAttributesSample {
077    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SetProfileAttributesSample.class);
078
079    private SetProfileAttributesSample() {
080    }
081
082    public static void main(String[] args) {
083        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
084        ProfileAttributes.Builder builder = ProfileAttributes.builder()
085                .comments(Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_COMMENTS", "true")))
086                .constraints(Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_CONSTRAINTS", "true")))
087                .caseSensitiveValues(Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_CASE_SENSITIVE_VALUES", "false")))
088                .maxTokens(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_MAX_TOKENS", "1024")));
089        applyOptionalString(builder::additionalInstructions, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_ADDITIONAL_INSTRUCTIONS");
090        applyOptionalString(builder::role, "SELECTAI_PROFILE_ROLE");
091        ProfileAttributes profileAttributes = builder.build();
092
093        try {
094            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
095            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
096            boolean updated = profile.setAttributes(profileAttributes);
097
098            System.out.printf("Set attributes on profile '%s' completed: %s%n", profileName, updated);
099            System.out.printf("Attribute payload: %s%n", profileAttributes.toJson());
100        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
101            LOGGER.error("Failed to set attributes for Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
102        }
103    }
104
105    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
106        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
107                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
108                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
109                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
110                .build();
111
112        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
113    }
114
115    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
116        String value = System.getenv(name);
117        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
118            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
119        }
120        return value;
121    }
122
123    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
124        String value = System.getenv(name);
125        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
126    }
127
128    private static void applyOptionalString(StringAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
129        String value = System.getenv(envName);
130        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
131            setter.set(value);
132        }
133    }
134
135    @FunctionalInterface
136    private interface StringAttributeSetter {
137        void set(String value);
138    }
139
140}
